title: Silos, hayfields and apple orchards
body: Merge Fields has twin grain silos joined by an overhead catwalk, with a steel water tower beside the road. Farmland now sits on broad, flat valley floors with mown rows and round hay bales. Orchard Creek Valley has rows of apple trees, a ladder and harvest crates.

images.alt: Twin corrugated grain silos next to a red barn, joined by a metal catwalk.
Steel water tower on a braced frame beside a road and a red farm building.
Rows of cut hay with round bales across a fenced valley field.
Rows of apple trees with a ladder and stacked harvest crates in the foreground.
